controlling_contract.queue: Media3 timeline and occurrence/index are authoritative
controlling_contract.position: Media3 currentPosition is live authority; persistence is restoration metadata only
controlling_contract.session: one MediaSession over the same service player
controlling_contract.play_intent: playWhenReady, isPlaying, playbackSuppressionReason, STATE_ENDED, and fatal PlaybackException state remain distinct
controlling_contract.previous: > 5,000 ms restarts current; <= 5,000 ms selects previous or is a first-item no-op
controlling_contract.focus: Media3-owned; transient suppression retains intent unless the user pauses
controlling_contract.output_safety: Media3 becoming-noisy handling produces a true pause with no suppression
controlling_contract.failure: USER-DIRECTED; no automatic skip/retry state machine
controlling_contract.background: PlaybackService remains authoritative without an Activity
controlling_contract.long_lived_operation: no watchdog/reset architecture; bounded Q2.8 resource behavior accepted

Q2.1.principal_semantics: single Media3 queue, occurrence-aware current identity, play-intent controls, manual traversal, repeat and shuffle
Q2.1.principal_evidence: focused unit and bounded real Media3/service queue-command authority
Q2.1.major_limitation: exact restored shuffle permutation is not promised

Q2.2.principal_semantics: one live Media3 clock, normalized seeks, drag isolation, bounded restoration
Q2.2.principal_evidence: semantic boundary tests and bounded player/service seeking authority
Q2.2.major_limitation: end completion belongs to Q2.3 rather than a separate seek guarantee
Q2.2.regression_trigger: seek, position, ticker, duration, or restoration changes

Q2.3.principal_semantics: Media3-owned automatic/manual/repeat/shuffle transitions and final-ended restart
Q2.3.principal_evidence: real transition matrices, background/reconnect checks, and WAV/FLAC/MP3/AAC path signals
Q2.3.major_limitation: sample-perfect or acoustic gapless output is not established
Q2.3.regression_trigger: transition, repeat, shuffle, end-boundary, or gapless-path changes

Q2.4.principal_semantics: Media3-owned focus with explicit play-intent and suppression distinction
Q2.4.principal_evidence: real API 36 F1–F9 focus grant/loss/gain/background/reconnect authority
Q2.4.major_limitation: exact acoustic duck attenuation is not established
Q2.4.regression_trigger: audio focus, play intent, suppression, or primary-control changes

Q2.5.principal_semantics: one service session, coherent external controls, notification, lifecycle, and background projection
Q2.5.major_limitation: cold media-button resumption without an active session is deferred
Q2.5.regression_trigger: MediaSession, notification, background, task lifecycle, or media-key changes

Q2.6.principal_semantics: Media3 becoming-noisy safety pause distinct from focus suppression
Q2.6.major_limitation: physical wired, Bluetooth, OEM route, DAC, and acoustic authority is deferred
Q2.6.regression_trigger: becoming-noisy, audio attributes, output safety, or route-observation changes

Q2.7.principal_semantics: stable failed occurrence with one bounded user-directed retry/navigation recovery
Q2.7.principal_evidence: real API 36 E1–E14 missing, zero, garbage, truncated, background, reconnect, and recovery authority
Q2.7.regression_trigger: playback error, retry, navigation recovery, or stale-source changes

Q2.8.principal_semantics: unchanged one-player/session lifecycle with bounded long-lived resource behavior
Q2.8.principal_evidence: 45:00.186 wall-clock run, 200 natural transitions, shuffle/repeat supplement, lifecycle/control churn, late Q2.7 recovery, and bounded screen-off continuity
Q2.8.major_limitation: multi-day, universal OEM, physical battery/thermal, Bluetooth endurance, and universal memory claims are not established
Q2.8.regression_trigger: service, player, listener, coroutine, controller, persistence-cadence, or long-lived resource changes
